assessment.cd74_structure_context: A near-full experimental CD74-HLA-DR15 complex supports physical interface analysis, but the AlphaFold monomer is weak at that interface and does not establish a MIF-CD74 complex.
assessment.direction_match: not_established; held therapy cohorts include opposite directions and a near-null result
assessment.mif_structure_context: MIF has high-confidence predicted coverage and multiple experimental inhibitor-bound structures, establishing physical inhibitor compatibility but not a favorable MS intervention direction.
assessment.why_status_did_not_change: Physical tractability cannot replace component-specific adjusted association, causal attribution, or a clinically favorable intervention direction.

claim: Structure-informed context changes the physical-tractability description of MIF/CD74 but does not reopen it as a direction-matched MS therapeutic target.
project_use: Segregated direction-matched tractability context only; the grounded MIF/CD74 null remains authoritative.
relationship_note: The external structural context is orthogonal to the grounded therapeutic null and does not change lead status.

source.citation: AlphaFold DB predictions and RCSB PDB experimental structure metadata, interpreted alongside separately listed project-grounded artifacts.
source.label: V53 segregated MIF/CD74 structure and direction assessment

why_unverifiable: The structural inputs are external predictions or experimental records that the project did not experimentally reproduce; they remain context rather than project evidence.
